title: now_secs() panics on pre-epoch SystemTime
description: util.rs:7 now_secs() calls .unwrap() on duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH). If SystemTime::now() is before UNIX_EPOCH (misconfigured clock, some embedded targets), this panics. Library code consumed by 3 downstream servers should not panic on a recoverable condition. Should either return a Result or use unwrap_or_default()/saturating_as(). epoch_to_iso() at line 18 already handles the failure case gracefully with unwrap_or_default().
close_reason: Won't fix: SystemTime before UNIX_EPOCH indicates a misconfigured system clock. Panicking is the correct response — all downstream behavior (timestamps, snowflake IDs, token expiry) would be wrong anyway.
